verdict.rationale: dltHub documents a decorator-based Python API to schedule, refresh, and backfill deployed pipelines, and its orchestration product advertises scheduling and chaining. Open-source dlt otherwise relies on external schedulers such as Airflow, Dagster, or GitHub Actions, and runs on demand through pipeline.run(). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of cron-expression support, sub-hour schedule granularity, a documented manual-trigger UI/CLI for deployed pipelines, and independent corroboration of the scheduling features.
